excerpt.zh: 传感器报告[Root.GetName]周围的重重废墟中可能存在有趣的东西。
excerpt.en: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 传感器报告[Root.GetName]周围的重重废墟中可能存在有趣的东西。
texts.en: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].

sections.zh: 传感器报告[Root.GetName]周围的重重废墟中可能存在有趣的东西。
sections.en: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].

texts.zh:
我们发现了一只巨型腹足动物的化石，它不符合任何先前遭遇的物种，并被困在一块围绕[From.GetName]旋转的巨大冰块中。它的眼睛怒视前方，触手扬起，鼻口扭曲成可怕的样子，好像被定格在一道无声的狂啸之中。该生物似乎没有明显的智慧特征。

尽管其面目狰狞，我们的科学家认为如果能将其驯化，该生物可以为我们所用。他们建议提取一些DNA以供克隆。
texts.en:
We have discovered the fossilized remains of a gargantuan gastropod, matching no previously encountered lifeform, trapped within a huge block of ice circling [From.GetName]. Its eyes glare fiercely ahead, tentacles reared and muzzle twisted into a gruesome grimace, as if locked in a silent shout. The creature displays no apparent signs of sapience.

Despite its eerie visage, our scientists believe that if domesticated the creature could make a valuable asset. They recommend extracting some of its DNA for cloning.

texts.zh:
我们发现了一只巨型腹足动物的化石，它不符合任何先前遭遇的物种，并被困在一块围绕[From.GetName]旋转的巨大冰块中。它的眼睛怒视前方，触手扬起，鼻口扭曲成可怕的样子，好像被定格在一道无声的狂啸之中。该生物似乎没有明显的智慧特征。

可惜以我们目前的科技实力，无法将其复生。
texts.en:
We have discovered the fossilized remains of a gargantuan gastropod, matching no previously encountered lifeform, trapped within a huge block of ice circling [From.GetName]. Its eyes glare fiercely ahead, tentacles reared and muzzle twisted into a gruesome grimace, as if locked in a silent shout. The creature displays no apparent signs of sapience.

Unfortunately we currently lack the technology to bring it back to life.

label.zh: 提取基因样本并加以储存，以备未来使用。
label.en: Extract and store a DNA sample for future use.

label.zh: 这块冻肉看起来可真新鲜啊！
label.en: A well refrigerated meal. How refreshing!

texts.zh:
某种未知生命体被困在冰层之中，没人知道这生命体是从何处而来、到底经历了多么漫长的岁月。

我们的研究员已做好充分准备，打算复活这个生命体。
texts.en:
Trapped within in a mountainous slab of ice are the remains of a lifeform, the likes of which have never seen before. Who knows how far it has traveled through space and time.

Our researchers have made the necessary preparations to bring it back to life.

texts.zh: 我们利用化石的DNA成功地克隆出了一批巨型蛞蝓。它们于数周后发育成熟，重达20吨，并发展出了原始的智慧，会对简单的指令做出反应。尽管尚未表露出任何凶猛的本性，它们在被激怒时会分泌一种粘稠的毒液，而且它们的颜色也会随情绪而改变。因为它们相互沟通之时会发出兹兹声，科研团队将其命名为“阿兹詹虫”。
texts.en: We have successfully cloned a healthy population of gargantuan slugs from the fossilized DNA. They reached maturity within weeks, weighing up to 20 tons, and have developed a primitive level of sapience, responding to simple one-syllable commands. Though they have yet to show any violent tendencies, they produce a thick, toxic mucus when vexed, and their hue seems to shift with their mood. The research team has named them 'Azizians' for the hissing sounds with which they communicate among themselves.

label.zh: 它们会成为优秀的奴隶。
它们应该待在动物园里。
我们可以把它们收编进军团。
label.en: We could use them in the army.

tooltips.zh: 谁不想要一大群凶猛的蛞蝓来碾压其敌人呢？
tooltips.en: Who would not want an army of murderous slugs with which to crush their enemies?

label.zh: 简直令人毛骨悚然。立即把它们处理掉！
label.en: They are horrendous. Dispose of them NOW!
We have seen enough. Butcher them now.

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]周围的垃圾场边缘，漂浮着一艘来源不明的破旧科研船。船壳上的咬痕与消化液表明它曾被某种大型食肉动物咀嚼，然后反刍。

讽刺的是，舰船的船员也在进行自己的美食之旅，寻找新的异星美味，结果自己却成了盘中餐。

他们对大量的物种进行了评估，从营养成分到咀嚼口感等各个方面。他们评价最高的物种之一是[delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，因其[delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesOrganName]多汁，而且性情暴躁。而我们则在排名底端得了中庸的评价，因为我们的肉嚼起来费劲，而且反抗无力。有些人还真喜欢与食物玩耍……
texts.en:
Floating on the outskirts of the debris field around [From.GetName] is the pitiful form of a crumpled-up science vessel of unidentifiable origin. The presence of bite-marks and digestive fluids on the hull suggest it was chewed up, then regurgitated by some large predator.

Ironically, the ship's crew were on a culinary odyssey of their own, in search of new exotic delicacies, when they themselves ended up on the menu.

They had rated a staggering number of lifeforms on everything from nutritional content to chewiness. Among their top picks were the [delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesNamePlural], for their juicy [delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesOrganName] and spicy temperament. We have earned a mediocre placement at the bottom of the list thanks to the stringiness of our flesh and the lackluster quarry we make. Some like to play with their food...

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]周围的垃圾场边缘，漂浮着一艘来源不明的破旧科研船。船壳上的咬痕与消化液表明它曾被某种大型食肉动物咀嚼，然后吐了出来。

讽刺的是，舰船上的船员也在进行自己的美食之旅，寻找新的异星美味，结果自己却成了盘中餐。

他们已经从营养成分到咀嚼口感等各个方面对海量物种进行了评估。他们首选的是[delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，因为[delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesOrganName]鲜美多汁且性情暴躁。我们在这份列表中排名很低，被归入了一种以星号圈起的特殊类别，因为我们根本不可食用并且毫无猎取的乐趣。有些人还真喜欢与食材玩耍……
texts.en:
Floating on the outskirts of the debris field around [From.GetName] is the pitiful form of a crumpled-up science vessel of unidentifiable origin. The presence of bite-marks and digestive fluids on the hull suggest it was chewed up, then regurgitated by some large predator.

Ironically, the ship's crew were on a culinary odyssey of their own, in search of new exotic delicacies, when they themselves ended up on the menu.

They had rated a staggering number of lifeforms on everything from nutritional content to chewiness. Among their top picks were the [delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesNamePlural], for their juicy [delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesOrganName] and spicy temperament. We have earned a special category at the bottom of the list surrounded by asterisks, thanks to the utter inedibility of our flesh and the lackluster quarry we make. Some like to play with their food...

label.zh: 看来他们终于碰到对手了……
label.en: Looks like they finally met their match...

tooltips.zh: 已经与星系最美味的外星生物[delicious_aliens.GetName]成功建立起联络。
tooltips.en: Communications enabled with the [delicious_aliens.GetName], the galaxy's most delicious aliens.

label.zh: 不排复杂度排什么口感？真奇怪。
label.en: Rating by taste rather than complexity? How odd.

tooltips.zh: 已经与星系最美味的外星生物[delicious_aliens.GetName]成功建立起联络。
tooltips.en: Communications enabled with the [delicious_aliens.GetName], the galaxy's most delicious aliens.

texts.zh: 我们在垃圾中找到了一颗原本可以居住的星球的碎片。破碎的方式与碎片上的焦痕表明，它受到了集束热能的冲击，直到它在压力下裂开为止。这使其矿物丰富的核心可以外泄，并固化成高品质矿物块。
texts.en: Among the debris we have discovered the shattered remains of a formerly habitable planet. The patterns of fragmentation and charring on the shards suggest it was blasted with concentrated beams of thermal energy until it cracked from the pressure. This allowed for the mineral-rich core to spill out and solidify into clumps of high-quality minerals.
